key.name: enabled
key.summary: Lock the screen when nobody is in front of the camera

key.name: idle-seconds
key.summary: Seconds without input before the camera starts looking

key.name: absent-checks
key.summary: Looks in a row without a face before locking

key.name: camera
key.summary: Camera device; empty uses Howdy's camera, or /dev/video0

key.name: away-command
key.summary: Command asked before locking when nobody is there
key.description: Run (as a shell command line) when nobody is there, instead of locking. Exit 0 means it takes over and will lock the screen itself when done; anything else, or no answer within a few seconds, and the screen locks now.
